overview: The Medford School Committee approved an international student trip to Argentina, reviewed updates on district security, and received presentations on elementary school math learning walks and the new police PALS partnership.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the September 23, 2019 meeting.

items.title: Approval of Bills, Transfer of Funds, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved bills, payrolls, and fund transfers following questions regarding gym equipment, HVAC improvements, and rink expenses.

items.title: Rules Subcommittee Report: Attendance Policy
items.summary: Received a subcommittee report detailing plans to draft a comprehensive district attendance policy and remove the procedure barring students absent on Friday from weekend school activities.

items.title: Report on PALS Program
items.summary: Received a presentation on the Partnership for Advanced Leadership Skills, a police department initiative incorporating elementary school reading sessions, social skills lunches, and the Michigan Model curriculum.

items.title: Superintendent's Update and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent provided updates on cultural field trips, middle school athletics, diversity initiatives, LGBTQ-inclusive presentations, and the district's free breakfast program.

items.title: Field Trip to Argentina
items.summary: Approved a high school field trip to Argentina scheduled to visit local schools and cultural sites.

items.title: Buildings and Grounds Security Update
items.summary: Approved the security report with an amendment to include a director of security position in upcoming budget discussions after reviewing parking management and a planned reporting app.

items.title: Report on Ongoing Math Learning Walks
items.summary: Accepted an update on the elementary and secondary mathematical learning walks being implemented across the district.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Adopted condolence resolutions for Charles Ferranti, Angela Keddie, Anthony Ardanga, and Leo Diversion, Jr.
